launches.title: Fuchsia | Vanta for hardware
launches.tagline: Hardware compliance done on your timeline
launches.body:
**TL;DR**: We’re an AI-native service that takes hardware products from design → testing → market, without the traditional compliance drag in between. We cover a wide range of testing & documentation across RF & EMC, environmental, shock & vibe, functional safety, electrical, machinery and more through our internal experts and partner labs. No inflated billed-hours, fully handled and traceable. Book a call here: <https://cal.com/tony-gao-fuchsia/20min>

**The problem:** Hardware teams waste time chasing consultants and lawyers just to end up with the same issues. We've seen founders and engineers slowed down by response times, get “overtested” by labs, and billed by contractors for inflated hours. 

Regulatory compliance blocks deals, burns money, and can kill a product after all your hard engineering work.

**How we help:** Give us your product specs and target markets. We’ll work through thousands of pages of standards and case studies to surface every requirement, risk, and gap for your product, e.g. radiated emissions limits, IP ratings, MTBF targets, drop and vibration profiles. Our AI agents find gaps and maintain traceability to speed up the process and cut what takes traditional consultants the longest.

We draft all your technical files and test plans, then handle conversations with testing labs directly. You won't be scheduling calls, translating requirements, or on long email chains, just check our dashboard for the stage your product is at and focus on what you do best (and want to do).

**Why:** Regulatory compliance favors big companies. They have the capital for huge compliance teams and the relationships to fast-track certification. Startups push out way more innovative products by volume, but the system makes it hard for them to actually get to market. 

We’re trying to disrupt this system so that the best products can have the best distribution. 

**Ask:** If you're building robots, medical devices, or IoT, book a call and we'll map your fastest path to _certified_: <https://cal.com/tony-gao-fuchsia/20min>

<https://youtu.be/epMVQDNfy-4>

launches.title: Noetic - Vanta for hardware
launches.tagline: Automating compliance workflows to get hardware to markets 10x faster
launches.body:
Building hardware is hard enough. Having to think about compliance too is just overkill. Noetic streamlines the entire certification and testing process using AI agents, making it **significantly faster and cheaper** than legacy consultants.

<https://youtu.be/vbFukT9hQkc>

**The Problem**

* Hardware compliance is scattered, complicated, and opaque
* Teams spend months and tens of thousands of dollars before ever even testing
* Critical information is scattered across thousands of pages of regulations and standards
* Mistakes lead to months in delays, expensive re-testing, and lost deals

**The Solution**

* Give us your product specs and target markets
* Our AI agents analyze thousands of pages of standards and case studies specific to your product
* We compile the necessary technical files and test plans, industry professionals review and sign off
* Your product is sent to the right NRTL/accredited testing lab in our network
* Track progress through a dashboard instead of having to get hands-on
* Within weeks, you have a certified product and the documentation needed for customers and regulators to approve deployment. And all you had to do was send some documents

**The Team**

We are a team of Yale dropouts with backgrounds in frontier robotics from perception research to humanoid deployments, with experience in big tech, AI startups, and quant trading firms. 

**If you or someone you know is building hardware, we'd love to show you exactly what your path to certification looks like and how we can handle it faster than any consultant you’ll ever talk to. FCC, FAA, ISO, IEC, ANSI, UL, ASTM, MIL-STD, the list goes on.**

Learn more at [getnoetic.ai](http://getnoetic.ai) and reach out at [founders@getnoetic.ai](mailto:founders@getnoetic.ai)
